standard-dialogue-after-the-ascent-of-ar.npc: Hello there. Thank you for helping us, you are a good friend to the people of Arceuus.

standard-dialogue-after-the-ascent-of-ar.player: It's not a problem. What brings you here?

standard-dialogue-after-the-ascent-of-ar.npc: I come here quite often now. This is a nice quiet place for me to think and reflect. It's my way of remembering Thana.

standard-dialogue-after-the-ascent-of-ar.player: I'll leave you in peace then.

standard-dialogue-after-a-kingdom-divide.npc: Hello there. Did you manage to get that device hidden?

standard-dialogue-after-a-kingdom-divide.player: Oh yes. Got it all done with no problems at all.

standard-dialogue-after-a-kingdom-divide.npc: Good. Hopefully Kourend will have no more issues with the Disciples of Yama.
